purpose: Reproducible paired driver for frozen named recv and recv_timeout hot-path benchmark

build_workflow.policy: cargo clean --release -p execute before each arm; compile baseline then candidate sequentially; copy each arm to its own immutable evidence binary before the next clean
build_workflow.fresh_interpretation: Cargo fresh=false confirms rustc compiled the artifact after the explicit package release clean

retry_policy: none; retain and report every invocation outcome
cross_arm_oracle: canonical signature over all case/sample identities, counts, checksum, and queue-order metadata must match
freshness_checks: source freeze and exact transport source hash before each arm receipt
source tree fingerprint, side-specific patch hash, harness hash, and exact side receipt
pinned sequential clean/build workflow, Cargo JSONL artifact, clean/build logs, and test list
distinct immutable saved binary paths and recorded full binary SHA-256 values
source, receipts, build provenance, and saved binary identities rechecked after all invocations
report: new report directory with per-attempt raw JSON, stdout, stderr, result, pair records, summary, and post-run identity check
execution_status: source, build, receipt, and binary preflight passed; paired benchmark timing not run
